title: Seed of the composed verifier
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions, and let $K$ be a positive integer. Given a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with $K$ clauses, a seed of the original verifier and a clause index among the $K$ clauses form a seed of the composed three-query verifier.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a Boolean PCPP system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions
a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
